problem: "The journal centre moves closer to the bearing" is ambiguous. The journal centre moves away from the bearing centre (the geometric centre of the sleeve) and toward the bearing surface; a student can read it the wrong way round.
fix: "Lower viscosity gives lower film pressure at the same speed and load, so the journal centre moves away from the bearing centre and nearer the bearing surface: ε increases and h_min = c(1 − ε) decreases."

problem: "A larger c raises oil flow and hmin" states h_min as always rising with clearance. In practice h_min improves with clearance only up to an optimum; past that, the extra flow cannot remove the heat, viscosity drops and h_min falls again. The sentence as written is a half-truth.
fix: "A larger c raises oil flow and lowers the temperature rise, and h_min improves up to an optimum clearance; beyond that optimum the fall in viscosity dominates and h_min drops again. Load capacity falls as c grows."
